specName: The canvas and the mod read the shared viewer core
request:
Issue #1031 (slices S and M, logic only) and #983 V11: the Copilot canvas and the Claude Code mod use speckit-viewer/core instead of hand-written duplicates. The PR body says `Part of #1031` and `Part of #983` (the canvas Overview render and the L slice follow in later PRs).

Owner's settled decisions (do not re-ask):
- "Import instead of vendor" means bundled at build time: the canvas ships as a copied folder with no node_modules, so apps/copilot-canvas/build.mjs bundles one `vendor/viewer-core.mjs` from packages/viewer/src/core subpaths (conditions ['source']), folding in today's vendor/step-history.mjs.
- Replace only what matches core exactly: tasks.mjs countTaskCheckboxes → core; PIPELINE_STEPS, statusRank and the running/done status tables built from core's DEFAULT_PIPELINE_STEPS, STATUSES and STEP_STATUS. Keep the canvas's own deriveStepBadges, specStatusLabel, listTasks (needs raw text and phase), phaseProgress and every board-only rule (live run, board timing, file reconciliation): core behaves differently there.
- The canvas Overview (overview.mjs) reads its data from core's deriveViewerState(ctx) and markMissingTests instead of the raw record, keeping its current HTML. This fixes concerns read from `what` instead of `note`.
- The Claude Code mod (apps/claude-mod/build.mjs gains conditions ['source']) gets core through the bundle chain, and its Overview model (hooks/board.js overviewModel) reads deriveViewerState so the pane shows the same proof rows (#983 V11).
- Update CLAUDE.md's "share no code with apps/vscode/" rule to say the canvas and the mod bundle packages/viewer (and the two apps/vscode files build.mjs already bundles) at build time.
- Run `npm run canvas:build` and `npm run mod:build` and commit the regenerated vendor bundles and mod fixtures; `npm run test:canvas` and the mod tests must pass; CI fails on a stale bundle. Changelog lines only where a user sees a change (the canvas concerns fix, the mod's richer Overview) in apps/copilot-canvas/CHANGELOG.md and apps/claude-mod/CHANGELOG.md. No version bumps.
